title: Drug use disorders and substance-induced psychosis
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's substance use disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for cannabis use.

HPI
Pt is an 83 y.o. female presenting for f/u regarding cannabis use disorder. Pt reports she is currently cutting down on her intake. She notes she is motivated to reduce usage but finds it difficult at times. She denies any acute concerns or recent complications related to use. She reports stable mood and functioning.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily
Melatonin 3mg PRN for sleep

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Resp: CTAB.
Neuro: NAD.
Psych: Appropriate affect, cooperative.

Assessment
1. Cannabis use disorder, mild. Pt is currently in the process of cutting down.

Plan
1. Continue to monitor cannabis use disorder. Pt to continue current efforts to cut down.
2. F/u in 4 weeks to monitor progress and provide support.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
May 14, 2026
explanations: Mild cannabis use disorder = cannabis abuse, uncomplicated: F12.10 (no HCC; V28 excludes cannabis abuse).
